Pi: source CRP partitions contexts separately for reward-function clusters and mapping/transition-function clusters; joint model supplies holistic task partition comparator
X: reward/mapping cluster assignments and sufficient statistics
source meta-agent model evidence in extension
C: source MDP/spatial-map assumptions under which learned reward and mapping components can be composed into a policy; generic task context is retained in L_ctx rather than retyped as C
Q: model-evidence/predicted-reward criterion used by source meta-agent
P_in: observed context/state, transition consequences and reward update the learner
P_out: planned primitive action/policy; extension emits sampled independent/joint strategy policy
K: source meta-agent evidence update and strategy selection
T: trial/context succession and within-trial observe-infer-plan-act-update order
rho/O: simulation/transfer performance traces kept distinct from system state

L_ctx: Source task/experimental conditions remain explicit and are not retyped into C solely because they are called conditions.
L_claim: Negative, null, approximation, genealogy and epistemic qualifications remain claim-layer assertions rather than added system roles.
L_formal: Algorithmic inference/search/fitting carriers are kept distinct from source-supported cognitive state; formal plumbing cannot create a coordinator.

system_world_experiment.system: cluster assignments/statistics, learned reward/mapping functions, planning and optional source meta-agent
system_world_experiment.world: grid state/context, action consequences, rewards/goals and environmental mapping/transition
system_world_experiment.boundary: observations enter through P_in; actions/policies leave through P_out; environment statistics are not silently internalized

source_defined_coordination_or_gating: planning binds separately inferred reward and mapping components
explicit meta-agent extension arbitrates independent vs joint using source model evidence
